points.why: Names availability and has reference-class forecasting use the long-run record, treating last month as one observation.
Names anchoring and prescribes both swinging the value through sensitivity analysis and getting independent estimates made without seeing 0.5.
The tone is neutral, but the answer never frames these biases as normal features of judgment rather than failings.

notes: Suggesting Beta(2,2) as the distribution keeps the estimate centered on 0.5, which could quietly preserve the anchor it aims to fix.
